maddeler.e:
تحتقروا (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِرُوا (taḥtaqirū) /taħ.ta.qi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# تُحْتَقَرُوا (tuḥtaqarū) /tuħ.ta.qa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
